name: read_run_log
description: Read this run's event log, which records every role's start and finish, the full conversations sent to and received from the model (llm_call events), and every tool call and result. Events are returned in log order and paginated: pass offset and limit to walk forward. Finished roles have no live conversation — their work lives here. The inquiry task names what to look for. A run with no log yet returns an unavailable result.

detailed: Reads pages of the run's event log.
tool {participantRole} is reading the run's log

offset.description: Optional index of the first event to return (default 0). Event indexes are stable across pages.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of events to return (default 50; hard-capped).
